verdict.rationale: The GitHub repo shows a clear self-host path ('Run Autumn: bun dev' to launch a local dashboard at localhost:3000), and docs describe Autumn as an 'open-source control layer,' confirming the core product can be run locally/self-hosted. However, evidence lacks details on production self-hosting (Docker/Helm, scaling guidance beyond dev mode, data persistence, or self-hosted billing integration with Stripe), and community threads focus on Stripe-only dependency and security concerns rather than self-hosting experience. Missing for 10: production deployment docs (Docker/K8s), self-hosted infra requirements, and independent confirmation of running it at scale outside dev mode.
